deploy-bot: [deploy started] env=prod region=us-east-1 user=release-orch

Services and commits being deployed:
- api-service @ ab12cde (PR #1823) - author jeff.kim - https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/commit/ab12cde
- inference-runtime @ f4e9b77 (PR #1902) - author carla - https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/commit/f4e9b77
- web-console @ 3b7a9f1 (PR #1799) - author alice.nguyen - https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/commit/3b7a9f1

Canary policy: 10% traffic for 10m -> promote if error_rate < 0.5% and latency p95 within baseline
Change window: 23:00-02:00 UTC (rolling by region)
Deploy ID: dpl_20240301_0845

alice.nguyen: quick q — did the runtime PR include the KV cache fix we patched last week? I saw a revert tag on the branch earlier.

carla: runtime PR #1902 is the kv-cache work, yeah. I rebased main this morning and fixed a small edge case; author is me. Tests passed on my branch but CI had one flaky test earlier.

jeff.kim: noted. api-service ab12cde also touches auth header parsing — should be fine but want to watch auth-related 401s in the canary.

infra-sre: canary infra update: inference-runtime f4e9b77 nodes showing a spike in 5xx at +4m into canary. Sample logs: https://logs.redwood-inference/prod/1747654321/runtime/ node-3 -> stack: kv_cache.lookup -> nil deref (traces attached)

build-bot: canary smoke results:
- api-service ab12cde: OK (0 failures)
- web-console 3b7a9f1: OK (0 failures)
- inference-runtime f4e9b77: 4 failing smoke tests (latency/timeouts) -> CI job: https://ci.redwood-inference/runtime/1902/artifacts

deploy-bot: [auto-action] Pause deploy: canary_failure detected for inference-runtime f4e9b77 (error_rate 2.6% > threshold). Auto-rollback policy TRIGGERED.
Actions taken:
- Rolled back inference-runtime from f4e9b77 -> e1d3a22 (previous stable sha) 
- Kept api-service@ab12cde and web-console@3b7a9f1 promoted
- Tagged deploy as PARTIAL_SUCCESS; runtime pinned to e1d3a22

release-manager: good catch. Carla — can you open a hotfix PR against e1d3a22 for the kv cache fix and mark it high priority? Also flag this for a post-mortem if root cause is non-trivial.

carla: opened hotfix PR #1920 -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1920. CI running, tests passing locally (I ran the kv-cache unit+integration suite). Will follow up on root cause and include minimal repro.

jeff.kim: given runtime rolled back, should we still proceed with promoting api and console? They look green.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished (partial) env=prod status=partial_success
- Promoted: api-service@ab12cde (PR #1823) by jeff.kim
- Promoted: web-console@3b7a9f1 (PR #1799) by alice.nguyen
- Pinned: inference-runtime@e1d3a22 (previous stable) due to canary failures on f4e9b77
Notes: runtime rollback occurred automatically; manual follow-up required for runtime rollforward after hotfix PR #1920 merges and CI passes.
Deploy summary links:
- commit list: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploys/dpl_20240301_0845/commits
- logs: https://logs.redwood-inference/prod/1747654321

release-manager: I'll draft release notes noting partial success and the runtime rollback (include SHAs + PR links). Will add action item to the weekly postmortem board. :clipboard: :eyes:

carla: thanks — I'll post a short issue with reproduction steps and timeline once CI finishes.

infra-sre: leaving alert muted for this deploy, will re-enable after runtime hotfix.

jeff.kim: thanks everyone — glad auto-rollback worked as intended.

build-bot: CI update: runtime PR #1920 tests -> SUCCESS (artifact: https://ci.redwood-inference/runtime/1920/artifacts)

deploy-bot: Planned next steps: when #1920 merges and CI green, schedule a targeted runtime canary (5% then 30%) with manual approval gate. Will post new deploy ID for that attempt.

release-manager: resolved for now; will circulate notes to partners. Great coordination. :tada:
